sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/380 (ReserveOhio API: place 380, facilities 565 and 832, all units 2027-06-15; sites 24148, 34099 on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Electric site $37 a night; full hookups $50. The same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $33, full-hookup sites included. The $27 non-electric sites are walk-in or tent sites, so they don't set the base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Campsite Full Hookup 50.00; Campsite Non-Electric and Campsite Tent Only 27.00, IsRVSite false, PullIn Not Applicable; Fee 6.50); sites 24148 and 34099 on Sat 2027-06-19 and off-peak dates, read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio details (Electricity Hookup 50 or 20,30,50; 33 sites typed and priced Campsite Full Hookup, with Water and Sewer Hookup keys on them) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/tar-hollow-state-park-campground ('Full hook-up , Electric, and Non-electric sites'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 67 sites a motorhome can use: 34 electric, 33 full hookup, 9 pull-through. Plus 26 tent or walk-in sites (31-34 are electric but tent only). The engine gives pad lengths on only 25 of the 67, 30-52 ft.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and details (UnitType, IsRVSite, Pad Length, PullInTypeName) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/tar-hollow-state-park-campground ('Some non-electric and electric sites are Tent Only because of their dimensions or other site conditions'; 'Suitability of a site to accommodate RVs or campers is noted on the reservation website'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Heated showerhouse closes Dec 5 to Apr 1; water then comes from across the dump station.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/tar-hollow-state-park-campground ('Showers'; 'Laundry facilities'; 'Flush toilets and pit latrines'; 'Dump station'; 'Off-peak: The heated showerhouse with flush restrooms closes Dec. 5 to April 1. Water is available across from the dump station'), read 2026-10-31

season.source: ReserveOhio search/grid for facility 565: sites bookable and priced ($33) on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/tar-hollow-state-park-campground (off-peak services described Dec 5 to Apr 1), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/tar-hollow-state-park-campground ('may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727'; 'Reservations are required') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

summary: Base $27->$37: the $27 sites are walk-in/tent (IsRVSite false); electric surcharge cleared, full hookup $23->$13 on the new base; added $33 off-peak. Added 50-amp/W/S, 67 RV sites (9 pull-through), showers/laundry/flush/vault/dump/water, year-round, deep link, 14-night max.
